minigame/ep2stages.3:
Drag the left side to move.
Hold the Sniff button and green cat scents trail toward the clues. Follow them and find 3 clues!
Pink Cesar scents are traps! Go there and Cesar treats appear—Bori won't listen for 5 seconds while eating.
Get caught in the robot vacuum's yellow sight and you're sent back to the start. Hide under furniture to stay hidden.
minigame/ep2stages.5:
Just then, the robot vacuum bumped the door sensor.
Beep-boop— the front door opened!
minigame/ep2stages.6: Sniff sniff... the cat scent leads to Gyeongan Stream! Woof!
minigame/ep2stages.10: All gone! Back to finding the cat scent!
minigame/ep2stages.12: A snack Sis left behind! Nom nom
minigame/ep2stages.14: Beep-beep! Fur ball detected! Back to the start...
minigame/ep2stages.23: Avoid pink Cesar scents! (stops 5s to eat)
minigame/ep2stages.26:
Bori runs on his own! Tap the screen to jump, hold for a high jump, tap again in the air for a double jump.
Jump over puddles, ducks and bikes; don't jump at low-flying pigeons—just pass under.
Collect snacks for a Zoomies invincible dash!

minigame/ep2stages.56:
Circles fly in from the right. The moment one overlaps the white circle on the left, anywhere on screen:
🩷 Paw → a quick tap
🩵 Down → swipe down with your finger
🧡 Bang! (mid-song) → swipe down, then mash → Bori rolls over sideways!
💛 Hold → keep pressing until the yellow bar ends
💜 Bori Begs → swipe up, then mash!
The move to do right now appears big in the center.

minigame/ep2stages.74: Paw=tap · Down=↓swipe · Bang=↓swipe+mash · Hold=press · Bori Begs=↑swipe+mash
minigame/ep2stages.81:
Drag left to move, Bite to attack! Woof! stuns nearby, Zoomies is an invincible dash.
When you see a red line, Nyanggaeng will pounce that way. Step aside to dodge!
After pouncing, Nyanggaeng stops, huffing and tired. Rush in and bite like crazy!
When the cuteness gauge is full, use the ultimate "Bori Begs"!

minigame/ep2stages.97:
① Zoomies Race Tap left and right alternately to run! Tapping the same side twice makes you slip.
When "Hold it!" appears, let go for a moment (don't get distracted by the ball)
② Tug-of-War Mash away! But let go during "Shake!".

minigame/ep2stages.127:
Drag the screen and Bori follows. No attacking—just survive 30 seconds!
Dodge syringes, thermometers and cotton swabs. Get hit by a cone collar and it's hard to see.
Don't step on the scale when it appears on the floor! Grab hearts to heal.

minigame/ep2stages.142:
Oppa's dozing, and something's on the line! Bori grabs the line in his mouth and pulls.
The green zone = the fish on the right gauge. It slowly darts up and down.
Hold to raise the white line, let go to lower it. Keep the white line inside the green zone to reel the fish in.
Push it to the red zone at the top and the line almost snaps!
minigame/ep2stages.143: The float... no, the whole reservoir is shaking!
minigame/ep2stages.144: The lord of the reservoir, the "Legendary Trophy Fish," leapt out of the water!
minigame/ep2stages.154: Keep the white line in the green zone (fish)!
minigame/ep2stages.158:
You can't bite the trophy fish in the water! Dodge its pounce (red circle) and it flops around on land. Attack then!
Watch out for droplets and waves too. Always finish with "Bori Begs"!
